geometry.geometry_scope: complete original axis-aligned pillar union plus explicitly extended closed ground slab
geometry.ground_adaptation: source finite open sheet extended to a closed slab; physical ground convention retained only in declared logical XY domain and z>=0
geometry.ground_union_semantics: pillar bottom faces are removed; occupied-side distances measure exposed union boundary, not raw internal faces
geometry.boundary_construction: axis-aligned face rectangle subtraction; no voxel approximation; T-junction-conforming centre-fan triangulation
geometry.oracle: float64 distance to exposed rectangles; union occupancy sign; independent of SdfLib and triangulation
geometry.t_junctions: rectangle edges split at every coincident axis-line corner before triangulation

morton_index.interval_semantics: sorted [start,end), complete cube, x bit first then y,z
morton_index.leaf_ids_semantics: interval row to original leaves.bin row

export_metadata.node_indices_semantics: original leaf row order; float leaf column 5 is always -1
export_metadata.query_leaf_ids_semantics: exact original leaf row per native query; float query column 10 is -1 if not exactly representable
export_metadata.polynomial: sum c[i+4*j+16*k] * u_x^i * u_y^j * u_z^k, u=(point-lo)/size, i,j,k=0..3
export_metadata.leaf_order: start grid z,y,x then depth first child x+2*y+4*z
export_metadata.query_points: Halton bases 2,3,5, indices 1..query_count, u=0.0001+0.9998*Halton; strictly inside bounds
export_metadata.native_gradient_semantics: glm::normalize(local polynomial gradient); may be nonfinite at zero gradient
export_metadata.raw_gradient_semantics: TriCubicInterpolation::interpolateGradient at native traversal local coordinates divided by leaf size

accuracy.oracle: float64 analytic exposed-rectangle distance and original-box/ground union occupancy

sampled_seams.scope: seeded subset of leaf-face interior points in logical domain, both polynomials at identical points; not exhaustive or a continuity certificate

semantics.geometry: actual 500-pillar map; exposed union boundary with ground half-space equivalence on logical domain
semantics.trajectory: finite sampled cost; dense independent probes are observations, not continuous clearance proof
